Container.Name: Alarm-HUB
Container.Overview: Alarm-HUB is a standalone multi-user alarm service with manual alarms, mobile API access, optional WebComm Calendar Sync integration, and optional direct WebComm import. PostgreSQL is embedded by default, so a normal Unraid installation requires only one container. Persistent application and database data are stored below /config.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: alarm alarms wecker webcomm schedule shortcut ios automation
Container.Requires: No separate PostgreSQL container is required for the default embedded database mode. For public Internet access, use a reverse proxy with a valid HTTPS certificate.
Container.Changes: Initial Community Apps release candidate with embedded PostgreSQL, persistent /config storage, external PostgreSQL advanced mode, WebComm integration, and direct WebComm import.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the Alarm-HUB WebUI.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Alarm-HUB data, including the embedded PostgreSQL database and generated application secret.

Config.Name: Database Mode
Config.Description: embedded = integrated PostgreSQL database (recommended); external = use your own PostgreSQL server.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Optional in embedded mode: when left empty Alarm-HUB creates and persists a strong secret under /config. Set and keep a fixed value for external/managed deployments if desired.

Config.Name: Secure Session Cookies
Config.Description: Use true behind HTTPS. Set false only for a local HTTP-only test installation.
